items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: I went on the road for a short period of time with little Richard

ctx.x: Okay. Okay. Reel number four with Red Tyler, June 19th, 1996. Okay. Yeah, you talked about Java and that you, you, that helped you join BMI.

Right. So I'm not quite sure if that's the first song that I had that was, it might've been, but for years I didn't get any royalties from BMI until I went on the road for a short period of time with little Richard and we played a polytheater and I went down to BMI and he said, we've been looking for you. I don't know why they couldn't find me. Yeah. Well, excuse me. And they gave me a check and say, you'll let you be getting a lot more checks from us.

And it was a check for Java. It was a check for, okay. So let's back up. So Java's a song that, that Alan Toussaint and, and you wrote. And what was the, let's go back. Cause that was a session for Alan.
